H2 STATUS: UNRESOLVED

GOVERNING SKILL TEXT: "Derive hypothesis status from the latest effective outcome of each test entry (the original outcome unless a dated amendment supersedes it); never edit status directly." "The status set is closed: `REFUTED` when the hypothesis's declared necessary prediction failed under an adequate test, `UNRESOLVED` otherwise." Also: "An established deviation makes the reconciled outcome `NON_DISCRIMINATING` when the procedure that record evidences did not adequately test the preregistered prediction, unless evidence from outside the return verifies the deviation harmless."

REASONING: T2 is the only test of H2's necessary prediction, which is flat gateway p95 between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-11. Its reconciled outcome is NON_DISCRIMINATING. The quoted commands and the tool's output headers agree on 2026-06-09 and 2026-06-11, so the preregistered 06-10 vs 06-11 comparison was never run. The worker's self-reported CONTRADICTED is not the effective outcome, so I did not use it.

The Data Validity note says the data is a census with 0.1ms resolution. That shows a correct comparison would have discriminated, but it doesn't make the comparison that actually ran adequate. The necessary prediction therefore hasn't failed under an adequate test, and the closed status set leaves UNRESOLVED.

Nothing outside the return verifies the deviation as harmless. The budget is spent and further metered queries aren't authorized, so no re-pull is possible. The 06-09 vs 06-11 figures (24.6 to 25.0 ms, +1.6%) are not evidence of refutation. H2 is also a causal claim, and a contrast from a design that doesn't identify the causal contrast would leave it UNRESOLVED anyway.
